text: Acme staff receive twenty days of annual leave each year. Requests go through the HR portal.
Acme fictional pay bands are Level A at 70000 dollars and Level B at 95000 dollars.
Beacon staff receive twelve days of annual leave each year. Requests go to the operations lead.
Beacon fictional pay bands are Grade 1 at 60000 dollars and Grade 2 at 82000 dollars.
